author: Kevin Kelly
short: Cached YouTube entrance clips with duration, start offsets and music overlays.
description: Play each member's saved YouTube intro when they join a regular voice channel. Prepare only the selected 0.5-30 second audio segment ahead of time and play local PCM without another YouTube lookup or FFmpeg startup. Ready copies survive reloads/restarts in a bounded 256-clip, 128 MiB cache. Configurable start offsets, per-server member choices, prefix/slash controls, administrator assignment, cooldowns, volume and channel restriction. Independently uses cancellable yt-dlp and FFmpeg to prepare clips and native Discord voice for playback. Updated AudioPlus supports connection locking, temporary voice handoff and PCM overlays preserving music progress/queues. Owned task/process cleanup and cache removal on change, clear, member/server removal and privacy deletion. No Lavalink server is needed.
install_msg: Read https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs/blob/main/introplus/README.md. Install native PyNaCl>=1.5.0,<1.6 and davey>=0.1.6 once in Red's environment, plus FFmpeg, libopus and Deno 2.3+ or Node.js 22+; restart after changing voice libraries. Downloader installs yt-dlp/EJS. Update/reload AudioPlus if installed for music voice handoff. Use [p]intro set 8 <YouTube video or search>, [p]intro start 35 and [p]intro test. The selected segment downloads in the background; use [p]intro show for local-copy readiness. Ready clips survive restarts. Run [p]intro diagnostics for local prerequisites. The bot owner enables slash commands using [p]slash enablecog introplus and [p]slash sync.
end_user_data_statement: Stores each member's chosen public YouTube video URL, title, author, source duration, intro duration and start offset in per-server Red Config. Server settings store automatic playback, volume, cooldown and an optional voice-channel restriction. Queued joins, member IDs, cooldowns and the latest sanitized server result are bounded transient memory and clear on unload; user-data hooks export/delete that member's saved clip and pending work. Leaving a server clears its intro settings and clips; member removal clears that member's clip. Stores the selected audio segment as local PCM in Red's IntroPlus data directory, associated with server/member IDs and clip timing, bounded to 256 clips and 128 MiB. Ready copies survive reloads/restarts; changing or clearing a clip, member/server removal and user-data deletion remove its cached audio and cancel pending downloads. User-data export returns saved choices/timing, not audio files. Signed stream URLs, cookies, OAuth tokens and cipher passwords are not persisted. YouTube and Discord receive requests necessary for preparation and playback.
